*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
INITIALIZATION.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
* 회사코드 기본 세팅(프로젝트 투입시 변경 필요)                                 
  PERFORM SET_BUKRS USING SY-TCODE
                 CHANGING P_BUKRS.
  PERFORM SET_LAYOUTA    CHANGING G_LAYOUT_S.
  P_BNAME = SY-UNAME.

  CLEAR ZFBT025.
  SELECT SINGLE *
           FROM ZFBT025
          WHERE BUKRS = P_BUKRS
            AND UNAME = SY-UNAME.
  IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
*    IF ZFBT025-APAY_DEAL = 'X' OR ZFBT025-APAY_APPR = 'X' OR                      &n
*      ZFBT025-FPAY_DEAL = 'X' OR ZFBT025-FPAY_APPR = 'X' OR                     &nbs
*      ZFBT025-MACC_DEAL = 'X' OR ZFBT025-MACC_APPR = 'X' OR                     &nbs
*      ZFBT025-FACC_DEAL = 'X' OR ZFBT025-FACC_APPR = 'X' OR                     &nbs
**      ZFBT025-GUME_DEAL = 'X' OR ZFBT025-GUME_APPR = 'X' OR                     &nb
*      ZFBT025-LAST_CONF = 'X' OR ZFBT025-LAST_CONF = 'X'.                       
*      GV_AUTH = SPACE.                                
*    ELSE.                                     &nb
*      GV_AUTH = 'Y'.                                &n
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*  ELSE.                                       &nb
    GV_AUTH = 'X'.
  ENDIF.

*&------------------------------------------------------------------*                               
*&      Form  USER_COMMAND                               &nb
*&------------------------------------------------------------------*                               
FORM USER_COMMAND USING  P_UCOMM    LIKE SY-UCOMM
                         P_SELFIELD TYPE SLIS_SELFIELD.

  CHECK P_UCOMM <> SPACE.

  CASE P_UCOMM.
    WHEN '&IC1'."더블클릭 이벤트 처리.
      PERFORM DB_CLICK USING P_SELFIELD.

    WHEN 'RFSH'. "리플레쉬
      CLEAR   IT_0102. REFRESH IT_0102.
      PERFORM SELECT_ZFBT102.
      PERFORM MODIFY_DATA.
      CLEAR   G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      REFRESH G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      PERFORM : ALVPRN_HEADER USING G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T[],
                SET_LAYOUTA CHANGING G_LAYOUT_S.
      P_SELFIELD-COL_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-ROW_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-REFRESH    = 'X'.

    WHEN 'CUST'.     "거래처입력
      PERFORM VAL_PROCESS_CUSTOMER.
      CLEAR   IT_0102. REFRESH IT_0102.
      PERFORM SELECT_ZFBT102.
      PERFORM MODIFY_DATA.
      CLEAR   G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      REFRESH G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      PERFORM : ALVPRN_HEADER USING G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T[],
                SET_LAYOUTA CHANGING G_LAYOUT_S.
      P_SELFIELD-COL_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-ROW_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-REFRESH    = 'X'.

    WHEN 'DOCU'.     "가수처리
      PERFORM VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT_GE.
      CLEAR   IT_0102. REFRESH IT_0102.
      PERFORM SELECT_ZFBT102.
      PERFORM MODIFY_DATA.
      CLEAR   G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      REFRESH G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      PERFORM : ALVPRN_HEADER USING G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T[],
                SET_LAYOUTA CHANGING G_LAYOUT_S.
      P_SELFIELD-COL_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-ROW_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-REFRESH    = 'X'.

    WHEN 'FINFO'.     "수수료정보
      PERFORM FEE_INFO_PRCESS.
      CLEAR   IT_0102. REFRESH IT_0102.
      PERFORM SELECT_ZFBT102.
      PERFORM MODIFY_DATA.
      CLEAR   G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      REFRESH G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      PERFORM : ALVPRN_HEADER USING G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T[],
                SET_LAYOUTA CHANGING G_LAYOUT_S.
      P_SELFIELD-COL_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-ROW_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-REFRESH    = 'X'.

    WHEN 'FDOCU'.     "수수료기표
      PERFORM VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT_FEE.
      CLEAR   IT_0102. REFRESH IT_0102.
      PERFORM SELECT_ZFBT102.
      PERFORM MODIFY_DATA.
      CLEAR   G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      REFRESH G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      PERFORM : ALVPRN_HEADER USING G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T[],
                SET_LAYOUTA CHANGING G_LAYOUT_S.
      P_SELFIELD-COL_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-ROW_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-REFRESH    = 'X'.

    WHEN 'DOCUCN'.     "입금전표 취소
      PERFORM VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT_CANCEL.
      CLEAR   IT_0102. REFRESH IT_0102.
      PERFORM SELECT_ZFBT102.
      PERFORM MODIFY_DATA.
      CLEAR   G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      REFRESH G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      PERFORM : ALVPRN_HEADER USING G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T[],
                SET_LAYOUTA CHANGING G_LAYOUT_S.
      P_SELFIELD-COL_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-ROW_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-REFRESH    = 'X'.

    WHEN 'FEE'.        "수수료입력
      PERFORM VAL_PROCESS_FEE_UPDATE.
      CLEAR   IT_0102. REFRESH IT_0102.
      PERFORM SELECT_ZFBT102.
      PERFORM MODIFY_DATA.
      CLEAR   G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      REFRESH G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      PERFORM : ALVPRN_HEADER USING G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T[],
                SET_LAYOUTA CHANGING G_LAYOUT_S.
      P_SELFIELD-COL_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-ROW_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-REFRESH    = 'X'.

    WHEN 'TEXT'.     "텍스트 입력
      PERFORM VAL_PROCESS_TEXT.
      CLEAR   IT_0102. REFRESH IT_0102.
      PERFORM SELECT_ZFBT102.
      PERFORM MODIFY_DATA.
      CLEAR   G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      REFRESH G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      PERFORM : ALVPRN_HEADER USING G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T[],
                SET_LAYOUTA CHANGING G_LAYOUT_S.
      P_SELFIELD-COL_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-ROW_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-REFRESH    = 'X'.


    WHEN 'PRNT'.
      READ TABLE IT_0102 WITH KEY MARK = 'X'.
      IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.
        MESSAGE E000 WITH '라인을 선택하세요'.
      ENDIF.

      CLEAR : G_FILE, GV_DIR.
      CREATE OBJECT OBJFILE.
      OBJFILE->GET_TEMP_DIRECTORY( CHANGING   TEMP_DIR         = G_FILE
                                   EXCEPTIONS CNTL_ERROR       = 1
                                          ERROR_NO_GUI         = 2
                                          NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_GUI = 3 ).
      OBJFILE->DIRECTORY_BROWSE( EXPORTING INITIAL_FOLDER    = G_FILE
                                 CHANGING SELECTED_FOLDER    = GV_DIR
                                 EXCEPTIONS CNTL_ERROR       = 1
                                            ERROR_NO_GUI     = 2
                                            NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_GUI = 3 ).
      LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK = 'X'.
        PERFORM PRINT_FIRM.
      ENDLOOP.

    WHEN 'A_DOCU'.     "일반계정처리(사용안함)
      PERFORM VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT_01.
      CLEAR   IT_0102. REFRESH IT_0102.
      PERFORM SELECT_ZFBT102.
      PERFORM MODIFY_DATA.
      CLEAR   G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      REFRESH G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.
      PERFORM : ALVPRN_HEADER USING G_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T[],
                SET_LAYOUTA CHANGING G_LAYOUT_S.
      P_SELFIELD-COL_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-ROW_STABLE = 'X'.
      P_SELFIELD-REFRESH    = 'X'.

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.                    "USER_COMMAND
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Module  USER_COMMAND_0200  INPUT                           &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
MODULE USER_COMMAND_0200 INPUT.

  CASE OK_CODE.
    WHEN '0200_OK'.
      UPDATE ZFBT102 SET ZTEXT100  = G_TEXT
                         EXCE_GUBN = G_EXCE_GUBN
                   WHERE ZBUKR     = IT_0102-ZBUKR
                     AND BANK_CODE = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
                     AND ENTE_CODE = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE
                     AND SEND_DATE = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
                     AND DOCU_CODE = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
                     AND UPMU_CODE = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
                     AND DOCU_NUMC = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC
                     AND TRNDT     = IT_0102-TRNDT
                     AND PART_SEQ  = IT_0102-PART_SEQ.
      IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
        COMMIT WORK. MESSAGE S100.
      ENDIF.
      LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.

    WHEN '0200_CN'.
      CLEAR OK_CODE. LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.
  ENDCASE.

ENDMODULE.                 " USER_COMMAND_0200  INPUT

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  ALVPRN_HEADER                               &n
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       TOP PAGE ITEM WRITE                             &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM ALVPRN_HEADER  USING    P_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T TYPE
                             SLIS_T_LISTHEADER.

  DATA: L_LINE_S TYPE SLIS_LISTHEADER,
        L_INFO   TYPE SLIS_LISTHEADER-INFO,
        L_TEXT   LIKE T001-BUTXT.
  DATA : LV_TEXT(30) TYPE C.

  SELECT SINGLE BUTXT
    INTO L_TEXT
    FROM T001
   WHERE BUKRS = P_BUKRS.

  CLEAR: L_LINE_S, L_INFO.
  L_LINE_S-TYP  = 'H'.
  PERFORM ALV_HEADER_PROGRAM_NAME
    USING SY-REPID L_LINE_S-INFO.
  APPEND L_LINE_S TO P_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.

  CLEAR: L_LINE_S, L_INFO.
  CONCATENATE P_BUKRS L_TEXT INTO L_INFO SEPARATED BY' '.
  L_LINE_S-TYP  = 'S'.
  L_LINE_S-KEY  = '회사코드 :'.
  WRITE L_INFO TO L_INFO.
  L_LINE_S-INFO = L_INFO.
  APPEND L_LINE_S TO P_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.

  CLEAR: L_LINE_S, L_INFO, LV_TEXT.
  L_LINE_S-TYP  = 'S'.
  L_LINE_S-KEY  = '거래일자 :'.
  IF P_RDATE-HIGH IS NOT INITIAL.
    WRITE : P_RDATE-LOW  TO L_LINE_S-INFO,
            P_RDATE-HIGH TO LV_TEXT.
    CONCATENATE L_LINE_S-INFO '~' LV_TEXT
           INTO L_LINE_S-INFO SEPARATED BY SPACE.
  ELSE.
    WRITE : P_RDATE-LOW  TO L_LINE_S-INFO.
  ENDIF.
  APPEND L_LINE_S TO P_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.

  CLEAR: L_LINE_S, L_INFO.
  L_LINE_S-TYP  = 'S'.
  L_LINE_S-KEY  = '지급건수 : '.
  L_INFO        = G_HCNT.
  L_LINE_S-INFO = L_INFO.
  CONCATENATE L_LINE_S-INFO '건' INTO L_LINE_S-INFO.
  APPEND L_LINE_S TO P_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.

  CLEAR: L_LINE_S, L_INFO.
  L_LINE_S-TYP  = 'H'.
  APPEND L_LINE_S TO P_LIST_TOP_OF_PAGE_T.

ENDFORM.                    " ALVPRN_HEADER

  CS_LAYO-F2CODE                 = SPACE.
  CS_LAYO-CONFIRMATION_PROMPT    = SPACE.
  CS_LAYO-KEY_HOTSPOT            = SPACE.
  CS_LAYO-FLEXIBLE_KEY           = SPACE.
  CS_LAYO-REPREP                 = SPACE.
  CS_LAYO-GROUP_BUTTONS          = SPACE.
  CS_LAYO-NO_KEYFIX              = SPACE.
  CS_LAYO-GET_SELINFOS           = 'X'     .
  CS_LAYO-GROUP_CHANGE_EDIT      = 'X'     .
  CS_LAYO-NO_SCROLLING           = SPACE.
  CS_LAYO-EXPAND_ALL             = SPACE.
  CS_LAYO-NO_AUTHOR              = SPACE.
*... Detailed screen                                     &nb
  CS_LAYO-DETAIL_POPUP           = 'X'  .
  CS_LAYO-DETAIL_INITIAL_LINES   = SPACE.
  CS_LAYO-DETAIL_TITLEBAR        = SPACE.
*... PF-status                                       &n
  CS_LAYO-DEF_STATUS             = SPACE.
*... Display variants                                     &n
  CS_LAYO-HEADER_TEXT            = SPACE.
  CS_LAYO-ITEM_TEXT              = SPACE.
  CS_LAYO-DEFAULT_ITEM           = SPACE.
*... colour                                        
  CS_LAYO-INFO_FIELDNAME         = 'HCOLOR'.
  CS_LAYO-COLTAB_FIELDNAME       = SPACE.
*... others                                        
  CS_LAYO-LIST_APPEND            = SPACE.

ENDFORM.                    " set_layouta
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  SELECT_ZFBT102                               &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM SELECT_ZFBT102 .

  RANGES : R_EXCE_GUBN FOR ZFBT102-EXCE_GUBN.
  CLEAR R_EXCE_GUBN. REFRESH R_EXCE_GUBN.

  IF P_EXCE = SPACE.
    MOVE : 'INEX' TO R_EXCE_GUBN. APPEND R_EXCE_GUBN.
  ENDIF.

  SELECT *
    INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE IT_0102
    FROM ZFBT102
   WHERE ZBUKR         =  P_BUKRS
     AND ( ( DOCU_CODE = '0200' AND UPMU_CODE = '300' ) OR
           ( DOCU_CODE = '0210' AND UPMU_CODE = '640' ) )
     AND BANK_CODE1   IN P_BANK
     AND UBKNT        IN P_UBKNT
     AND TRNDT        IN P_RDATE
     AND KUNNR        IN S_KUNNR
     AND EXCE_GUBN    IN R_EXCE_GUBN
     AND ( TRDIV      EQ '20' OR      "입금
           TRDIV      EQ '21' OR      "추심입금
           TRDIV      EQ '40' ).      "결산이자.

ENDFORM.                    " SELECT_ZFBT102
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  modify_data                               &nbs
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM MODIFY_DATA .
* 2012.06.24 분할처리 추가                                    &nbs
  DATA : LT_0102 LIKE ZFBT102 OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.
  DATA : LV_AMT  LIKE ZFBT102-TRAN_AMT.

  DATA : L_0102_T LIKE IT_0102 OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.
  DATA : L_AMT   LIKE BSEG-WRBTR.

  RANGES : R_KUNNR FOR KNA1-KUNNR.

  LOOP AT IT_0102.
* 2012.06.24 분할                                      &n
    CLEAR LT_0102. REFRESH LT_0102.
    IF IT_0102-PART_GUBN = SPACE.
      SELECT *
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE LT_0102
        FROM ZFBT102
       WHERE ZBUKR     = IT_0102-ZBUKR
         AND BANK_CODE = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
         AND SEND_DATE = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
         AND DOCU_CODE = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
         AND UPMU_CODE = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
         AND DOCU_NUMC = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC
         AND TRNDT     = IT_0102-TRNDT
         AND TRNNO     = IT_0102-TRNNO
         AND PART_GUBN = 'X'.

      CLEAR LV_AMT.
      LOOP AT LT_0102.
        LV_AMT = LV_AMT + LT_0102-TRAN_AMT.
      ENDLOOP.

      IT_0102-REMAIN_AMT = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT - LV_AMT.
    ELSE.
      IT_0102-REMAIN_AMT = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT.
    ENDIF.

    IF IT_0102-SYMBL   = '-'.
      IT_0102-BLNC_AMT = IT_0102-BLNC_AMT * -1 .
    ENDIF.
*   은행명                                       
    SELECT SINGLE TEXT FROM ZFBT056 INTO IT_0102-TEXT
                      WHERE BANK_CODE1 = IT_0102-BANK_CODE1.
*   부문이름                                      &nbs
*    SELECT SINGLE DDTEXT                                 &n
*             FROM DD07T                           
*             INTO IT_0102-PART_NAME                         
*            WHERE DOMNAME    = 'ZDPART_GUBN'                    
*              AND DDLANGUAGE = SY-LANGU                     &nbs
*              AND DOMVALUE_L = IT_0102-PART_GUBN.                    
*   계좌명                                       
    SELECT SINGLE TEXT1 FROM T012T INTO IT_0102-TEXT1
                        WHERE SPRAS = SY-LANGU
                          AND BUKRS = P_BUKRS
                          AND HBKID = IT_0102-HBKID
                          AND HKTID = IT_0102-HKTID.

    SELECT SINGLE HKONT FROM T012K INTO IT_0102-HKONT
                        WHERE BUKRS = P_BUKRS
                          AND HBKID = IT_0102-HBKID
                          AND HKTID = IT_0102-HKTID.
*   어음만기구분                                      &n
    IF IT_0102-BILNU <> SPACE.
      SELECT SINGLE *
        FROM ZFBT102
       WHERE ZBUKR         = P_BUKRS
         AND BANK_CODE     = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
         AND ( ( DOCU_CODE = '4000' AND UPMU_CODE = '501' ) OR
               ( DOCU_CODE = '4100' AND UPMU_CODE = '601' ) )
         AND BILNU         = IT_0102-BILNU
         AND TRNDT        GE IT_0102-TRNDT.
      IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
        IT_0102-TEXT2 = '어음만기분'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

**   거래구분                                      &nb
*    IF IT_0102-VIRT_FLAG = SPACE.                               
*      IT_0102-CLASS = '일반입금'.                               
*    ELSE.                                     &nb
*      IT_0102-CLASS = '가상계좌입금'.                              &nb
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*   거래처명                                      &nbs
    CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERSION_EXIT_ALPHA_INPUT'
      EXPORTING
        INPUT  = IT_0102-KUNNR
      IMPORTING
        OUTPUT = IT_0102-KUNNR.

    SELECT SINGLE NAME1 FROM KNA1 INTO IT_0102-KUNNRM
                       WHERE KUNNR = IT_0102-KUNNR.

* 입/출금/취소구분                                        
    CASE IT_0102-TRGUBN.
      WHEN '11' .
        IT_0102-GUBUNK     = '입금'.
        IT_0102-INAPP_AMT  = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT.
      WHEN '21'.
        IT_0102-GUBUNK     = '출금'.
        IT_0102-OUTAPP_AMT = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT.
      WHEN '31' .
        IT_0102-GUBUNK     = '입금취소'.
        IT_0102-INAPP_AMT  = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT * -1.
      WHEN '32'.
        IT_0102-GUBUNK     = '출금취소'.
        IT_0102-OUTAPP_AMT = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT * -1.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        IT_0102-GUBUNK     = '기타'.
        IT_0102-INAPP_AMT  = IT_0102-TRAN_AMT.
    ENDCASE.
* 거래구분명                                        &nb
    CASE IT_0102-TRDIV.
      WHEN '20' .
        IT_0102-TRDIVK     = '입금'.
      WHEN '21'.
        IT_0102-TRDIVK     = '추심입금'.
      WHEN '30' .
        IT_0102-TRDIVK     = '지급'.
      WHEN '31'.
        IT_0102-TRDIVK     = '부도지급'.
      WHEN '40' .
        IT_0102-TRDIVK     = '입금이자'.
      WHEN '41'.
        IT_0102-TRDIVK     = '출금이자'.
      WHEN '77'.
        IT_0102-TRDIVK     = '계좌이체'.
      WHEN '81' .
        IT_0102-TRDIVK     = '입금압축기장'.
      WHEN '82'.
        IT_0102-TRDIVK     = '출금압축기장'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        IT_0102-TRDIVK     = '기타'.
    ENDCASE.

    IF IT_0102-PART_GUBN = 'X'.
      IT_0102-PART_TEXT = '분 할'.
      IT_0102-HCOLOR    = 'C300'.
    ELSE.
      IT_0102-PART_TEXT = '일 반'.
    ENDIF.

    IF IT_0102-TRAN_AMT <> IT_0102-REMAIN_AMT.
      IT_0102-HCOLOR = 'C700'.
    ENDIF.

    IF IT_0102-BELNR = SPACE.
      IT_0102-LIGHTS = ICON_LED_RED.
    ELSE.
      IT_0102-LIGHTS = ICON_LED_GREEN.
    ENDIF.

    IF IT_0102-EXCE_GUBN = 'X'.
      IT_0102-TEXT10 = '제외처리'.
    ENDIF.

    "참조3넣을 고객명변경
    IF IT_0102-KUNNR IS NOT INITIAL AND IT_0102-KUNNRM IS NOT INITIAL.
      PERFORM KUNNR_NAME_CONV
        USING IT_0102-KUNNRM IT_0102-TEXT11.
    ENDIF.

    "전체수수료구분
    IF IT_0102-ALLFE = 'X'.
      IT_0102-TEXT12 = ICON_GENERATE.
    ENDIF.

    "총금액 = 입금액 + 수수료금액
    IT_0102-TOAMT = IT_0102-REMAIN_AMT + IT_0102-FEE_AMT.

    "전체수수료표기
    IF IT_0102-ALLFE = 'X'.
      IT_0102-TEXT12 = '√'.
    ENDIF.

    MODIFY IT_0102.     CLEAR IT_0102.
  ENDLOOP.

* 2012.06.24 분할처리 추가                                    &nbs
  SORT IT_0102 BY BANK_CODE UBKNT TRNDT TRNTM DOCU_NUMC PART_SEQ.

ENDFORM.                    " modify_data
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  DB_CLICK                                &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*      -->P_P_SELFIELD  text                              &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM DB_CLICK  USING    P_SELFIELD TYPE SLIS_SELFIELD.

  CASE P_SELFIELD-SEL_TAB_FIELD.
    WHEN    'IT_0102-BELNR' .
      IF P_SELFIELD-VALUE IS INITIAL.
        MESSAGE I000 WITH '값이 존재하는 필드만 더블클릭 하십시요!'.
      ELSE.
        CLEAR RF05L.
        CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERSION_EXIT_ALPHA_INPUT'
          EXPORTING
            INPUT  = P_SELFIELD-VALUE
          IMPORTING
            OUTPUT = RF05L-BELNR.
        READ TABLE IT_0102 INDEX P_SELFIELD-TABINDEX.
        RF05L-BUKRS = P_BUKRS.
        RF05L-GJAHR = IT_0102-TRNDT(04).

        SET PARAMETER ID 'BLN' FIELD RF05L-BELNR.
        SET PARAMETER ID 'BUK' FIELD RF05L-BUKRS.
        SET PARAMETER ID 'GJR' FIELD RF05L-GJAHR.
        CALL TRANSACTION 'FB03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.
      ENDIF.
    WHEN    'IT_0102-BELNR_B' .
      IF P_SELFIELD-VALUE IS INITIAL.
        MESSAGE I000 WITH '값이 존재하는 필드만 더블클릭 하십시요!'.
      ELSE.
        CLEAR RF05L.
        CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERSION_EXIT_ALPHA_INPUT'
          EXPORTING
            INPUT  = P_SELFIELD-VALUE
          IMPORTING
            OUTPUT = RF05L-BELNR.
        READ TABLE IT_0102 INDEX P_SELFIELD-TABINDEX.
        RF05L-BUKRS = P_BUKRS.
        RF05L-GJAHR = IT_0102-BUDAT_B(04).

        SET PARAMETER ID 'BLN' FIELD RF05L-BELNR.
        SET PARAMETER ID 'BUK' FIELD RF05L-BUKRS.
        SET PARAMETER ID 'GJR' FIELD RF05L-GJAHR.
        CALL TRANSACTION 'FB03' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.
      ENDIF.

    WHEN OTHERS.

  ENDCASE.

ENDFORM.                    " DB_CLICK

FORM  PF_STATUS_SET USING RT_EXTAB TYPE SLIS_T_EXTAB.

  CLEAR RT_EXTAB. REFRESH RT_EXTAB.
  SET PF-STATUS 'G0100' EXCLUDING RT_EXTAB.

ENDFORM.                    "PF_STATUS_SET

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  F4_BANK                                &n
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*      -->P_P_BANK_LOW  text                              &nbs
*      -->P_0333   text                              &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM F4_ACCT  USING    P_ACCT
                       P_FNAME.

  DATA : L_BANK       LIKE ZFBT027-BANK_CODE.
  DATA : SELECTFIELD  LIKE HELP_INFO-FIELDNAME,
         IT_FIELDS    LIKE HELP_VALUE OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,
         IT_HEAD      TYPE F4TYP_HEADING_TAB   WITH HEADER LINE,
         SELECT_VALUE LIKE HELP_INFO-FLDVALUE,
         IT_T012K     LIKE T012K      OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,
         LD_TABIX     LIKE SY-TABIX.
  DATA : L_BANK_LOW  LIKE ZFBT056-BANK_CODE1,
         L_BANK_HIGH LIKE ZFBT056-BANK_CODE1.

*  clear: SELECTFIELD, IT_FIELDS, SELECT_VALUE, LD_TABIX.                            
  CLEAR: DYNPREAD, DYNPREAD[].

  REFRESH: IT_FIELDS.

* F4를 눌렀을때 보여지는 필드 선언.                                  &nbs
  DATA : BEGIN OF IT_VALUE OCCURS 0,
           BANK_CODE1 LIKE ZFBT056-BANK_CODE1,
           BANKN      LIKE T012K-BANKN,
           TEXT       LIKE T012T-TEXT1,
         END OF IT_VALUE.

  DATA : BEGIN OF IT_BANK OCCURS 0,
           BANK_CODE1 LIKE ZFBT056-BANK_CODE1,
         END OF IT_BANK.

* 화면 필드 선언 -> 선택된 값을 화면 필드에 뿌려줄때 사용.                           &nbs
  DATA: SCR_FIELDS LIKE DYNPREAD OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE.

  DYNPREAD-FIELDNAME = 'P_BUKRS'.
  APPEND DYNPREAD.
*.....................INPUT HELP 내용을 채움                                 &nb
  CALL FUNCTION 'DYNP_VALUES_READ'
    EXPORTING
      DYNAME               = SY-CPROG
      DYNUMB               = SY-DYNNR
    TABLES
      DYNPFIELDS           = DYNPREAD
    EXCEPTIONS
      INVALID_ABAPWORKAREA = 1
      INVALID_DYNPROFIELD  = 2
      INVALID_DYNPRONAME   = 3
      INVALID_DYNPRONUMMER = 4
      INVALID_REQUEST      = 5
      NO_FIELDDESCRIPTION  = 6
      INVALID_PARAMETER    = 7
      UNDEFIND_ERROR       = 8
      DOUBLE_CONVERSION    = 9
      STEPL_NOT_FOUND      = 10.
  READ TABLE DYNPREAD INDEX 1.
  P_BUKRS  = DYNPREAD-FIELDVALUE.

  CLEAR: DYNPREAD, DYNPREAD[].

  DYNPREAD-FIELDNAME = 'P_BANK-LOW'.
  APPEND DYNPREAD.
  DYNPREAD-FIELDNAME = 'P_BANK-HIGH'.
  APPEND DYNPREAD.
*.....................INPUT HELP 내용을 채움                                 &nb
  CALL FUNCTION 'DYNP_VALUES_READ'
    EXPORTING
      DYNAME               = SY-CPROG
      DYNUMB               = SY-DYNNR
    TABLES
      DYNPFIELDS           = DYNPREAD
    EXCEPTIONS
      INVALID_ABAPWORKAREA = 1
      INVALID_DYNPROFIELD  = 2
      INVALID_DYNPRONAME   = 3
      INVALID_DYNPRONUMMER = 4
      INVALID_REQUEST      = 5
      NO_FIELDDESCRIPTION  = 6
      INVALID_PARAMETER    = 7
      UNDEFIND_ERROR       = 8
      DOUBLE_CONVERSION    = 9
      STEPL_NOT_FOUND      = 10.
  READ TABLE DYNPREAD INDEX 1.
  L_BANK_LOW  = DYNPREAD-FIELDVALUE.
  READ TABLE DYNPREAD INDEX 2.
  L_BANK_HIGH = DYNPREAD-FIELDVALUE.

  CLEAR: IT_BANK,IT_BANK[].
  IF L_BANK_LOW = SPACE AND L_BANK_HIGH = SPACE.
    SELECT * FROM ZFBT056
             INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE IT_BANK.
  ELSE.
    IF L_BANK_HIGH <> SPACE.
      IF L_BANK_LOW > L_BANK_HIGH.
        MESSAGE S000(ZFB01) WITH '하한선이 상한선보다 큽니다.'.
        STOP.
      ELSE.
        SELECT * FROM ZFBT056
                 INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE IT_BANK
                WHERE BANK_CODE1 GE L_BANK_LOW
                  AND BANK_CODE1 LT L_BANK_HIGH.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      SELECT * FROM ZFBT056
               INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE IT_BANK
              WHERE BANK_CODE1 EQ L_BANK_LOW.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  CLEAR: IT_VALUE, IT_VALUE[], IT_T012K, IT_T012K[].
  SELECT * FROM T012K
           INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE IT_T012K
          WHERE BUKRS = P_BUKRS
            AND WAERS = C_WAERS_KRW.

* 검색된 자료의 존재 여부.                                    &nb
  IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT IT_T012K.
    IT_VALUE-BANKN = IT_T012K-BANKN.
    SELECT SINGLE TEXT1 FROM T012T INTO IT_VALUE-TEXT
                       WHERE SPRAS = SY-LANGU
                         AND BUKRS = P_BUKRS
                         AND HBKID = IT_T012K-HBKID
                         AND HKTID = IT_T012K-HKTID.
    SELECT SINGLE BANKL FROM T012 INTO IT_VALUE-BANK_CODE1
                       WHERE BUKRS = P_BUKRS
                         AND HBKID = IT_T012K-HBKID.
    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      READ TABLE IT_BANK WITH KEY BANK_CODE1 = IT_VALUE-BANK_CODE1.
      IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
        APPEND IT_VALUE. CLEAR IT_VALUE.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      CLEAR IT_VALUE.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

  SORT IT_VALUE BY BANK_CODE1
                   BANKN.

*F4를 눌렀을때 Hit List를 보여준다.                                   
  IT_FIELDS-TABNAME   = 'ZFBT056'.
  IT_FIELDS-FIELDNAME = 'BANK_CODE1'.
  IT_FIELDS-SELECTFLAG = ' '. "실제 선택되는 값에 'X' 표시
  APPEND IT_FIELDS.
  IT_FIELDS-TABNAME   = 'T012K'.
  IT_FIELDS-FIELDNAME = 'BANKN'.
  IT_FIELDS-SELECTFLAG = 'X'. "실제 선택되는 값에 'X' 표시
  APPEND IT_FIELDS.
  IT_FIELDS-TABNAME   = 'T012T'.
  IT_FIELDS-FIELDNAME = 'TEXT1'.
  IT_FIELDS-SELECTFLAG = ' '. "실제 선택되는 값에 'X' 표시
  APPEND IT_FIELDS.

  IT_HEAD-TABNAME   = 'ZFBT0008'.
  IT_HEAD-FIELDNAME = 'BANK_CODE'.
  IT_HEAD-HEAD_TEXT = '은행코드'.
  APPEND IT_HEAD.

  IT_HEAD-TABNAME   = 'T012K'.
  IT_HEAD-FIELDNAME = 'BANKN'.
  IT_HEAD-HEAD_TEXT = '계좌번호'.
  APPEND IT_HEAD.

  IT_HEAD-TABNAME   = 'T012T'.
  IT_HEAD-FIELDNAME = 'TEXT1'.
  IT_HEAD-HEAD_TEXT = '계좌명'.
  APPEND IT_HEAD.

** F4기능 부분                                       &
  CALL FUNCTION 'HELP_VALUES_GET_NO_DD_NAME'
    EXPORTING
      SELECTFIELD                  = SELECTFIELD
    IMPORTING
      IND                          = LD_TABIX
      SELECT_VALUE                 = SELECT_VALUE
    TABLES
      FIELDS                       = IT_FIELDS
      FULL_TABLE                   = IT_VALUE
      HEADING_TABLE                = IT_HEAD
    EXCEPTIONS
      FULL_TABLE_EMPTY             = 1
      NO_TABLESTRUCTURE_GIVEN      = 2
      NO_TABLEFIELDS_IN_DICTIONARY = 3
      MORE_THEN_ONE_SELECTFIELD    = 4
      NO_SELECTFIELD               = 5
      OTHERS                       = 6.
*                                          &n
*  DOUBLE CLICK시 값을 화면에 DISPLAY                                &n

  CHECK NOT LD_TABIX IS INITIAL.
  READ TABLE IT_VALUE INDEX LD_TABIX.
  P_ACCT = SELECT_VALUE.           "표시될 화면 필드

*DESC을 바로 보여주기 위한 부분.                                   &nbs
*    표시될 화면 필드명 과 값                                &nbs

  SCR_FIELDS-FIELDNAME  = P_FNAME. "반드시 대문자.
  SCR_FIELDS-FIELDVALUE = IT_VALUE-BANKN.
  APPEND SCR_FIELDS.

  CALL FUNCTION 'DYNP_VALUES_UPDATE'
    EXPORTING
      DYNAME               = SY-CPROG
      DYNUMB               = SY-DYNNR
    TABLES
      DYNPFIELDS           = SCR_FIELDS
    EXCEPTIONS
      INVALID_ABAPWORKAREA = 1
      INVALID_DYNPROFIELD  = 2
      INVALID_DYNPRONAME   = 3
      INVALID_DYNPRONUMMER = 4
      INVALID_REQUEST      = 5
      NO_FIELDDESCRIPTION  = 6
      UNDEFIND_ERROR       = 7
      OTHERS               = 8.

  IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                                                    " F4_ACCT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  VAL_PROCESS_TEXT                               
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM VAL_PROCESS_TEXT.

  CLEAR : G_BANK, G_BANK_NAME, G_TRNDT, G_TRNNO, G_TRAN_AMT,
          G_FNAME, G_EXCE_GUBN.

  READ TABLE IT_0102  WITH KEY MARK = 'X'.
  IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.
    MESSAGE I006. EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK = 'X'.
    MOVE IT_0102-BANK_CODE       TO  G_BANK.
    MOVE IT_0102-TEXT            TO  G_BANK_NAME.
    MOVE IT_0102-TRNDT           TO  G_TRNDT.
    MOVE IT_0102-TRNNO           TO  G_TRNNO.
    MOVE IT_0102-TRAN_AMT        TO  G_TRAN_AMT.
    MOVE IT_0102-FNAME           TO  G_FNAME.
    MOVE IT_0102-ZTEXT100        TO  G_TEXT.
    CLEAR : OK_CODE, G_EXCE_GUBN.
    CALL SCREEN '0200'  STARTING AT  30  012.
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.                    " VAL_PROCESS_TEXT

FORM VAL_PROCESS_UPDATE.

*  READ TABLE IT_0102  WITH KEY MARK   = 'X'                         &
*                               BELNR  = SPACE      &nb
*                               TRGUBN = '11'.       &n
*  IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.                                   
*    MESSAGE I000 WITH '라인을 선택하세요.'.                              
*    EXIT.                                     &nb
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
*                                          &n
*  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK  = 'X'                             
*                    AND BELNR = SPACE.                 
*    CLEAR : GC_BELNR, G_GJAHR.                               &nb
*    CALL SCREEN '0100'  STARTING AT  30  012                        &
*                        ENDING   AT  80  020.         
*  ENDLOOP.                                       

ENDFORM.                    " VAL_PROCESS_UPDATE
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT                              &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT .

  DATA L_CHK1.
  READ TABLE IT_0102 WITH KEY MARK = 'X'.
  IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.
    MESSAGE S006. EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  "펌뱅킹 이체분 입금적요 관련 로직 체크
  CLEAR : L_CHK1, G_MESSAGE.
  LOOP AT IT_0102  WHERE MARK    EQ 'X'
                     AND BELNR   EQ SPACE
                     AND BELNR_B EQ SPACE
                     AND TRGUBN  EQ '11'
                     AND TRDIV   EQ '20'
                     AND REMAIN_AMT <> SPACE.

    IF IT_0102-FNAME = '사내계좌이체' OR
      IT_0102-FNAME = '자동집금당행' OR
      IT_0102-FNAME = '자동집금최종' OR
      IT_0102-FNAME = '외화매수지급' OR
      IT_0102-FNAME = '정기예금' OR
      IT_0102-FNAME = '차입금이체'.
      L_CHK1 = 'X'.
      CONCATENATE '처리 대상 중 시스템에서'
                  '이체한 [ 적요 :' IT_0102-FNAME
                  '] 　　　데이터가 존재합니다. 진행하시겠습니까?'
             INTO G_MESSAGE SEPARATED BY SPACE.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

  IF L_CHK1 = 'X'.
    PERFORM CONFIRM_POPUP
      USING '[선수처리 확인 Message]'
            G_MESSAGE SPACE SPACE
   CHANGING G_ANSWER.
    CHECK G_ANSWER = '1'.
  ENDIF.

*  "선수처리할 고객 입력                                    &nbs
*  CLEAR : G_KUNNR, G_NAME, G_EXIT, OK_CODE.                             &n
*  CALL SCREEN '0400' STARTING AT 15 005.                             
*  CHECK OK_CODE = '0400_OK'.                                 &nb

  LOOP AT IT_0102  WHERE MARK    EQ 'X'
                     AND BELNR   EQ SPACE
                     AND BELNR_B EQ SPACE
                     AND TRGUBN  EQ '11'
                     AND TRDIV   EQ '20'
                     AND KUNNR   NE SPACE
                     AND REMAIN_AMT <> SPACE.
    PERFORM RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION USING SPACE.
    G_EXIT = 'X'.
  ENDLOOP.

  IF G_EXIT = SPACE.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH '처리할 대상이 없습니다.'.
  ENDIF.

  IF G_SUBRC = 4.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH W_MSG.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT_CANCEL                             
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT_CANCEL .

  READ TABLE IT_0102  WITH KEY MARK = 'X'.
  IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH '라인을 선택하세요.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

*  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK   = 'X'                            
*                    AND BELNR <> SPACE.               &nbs
*    PERFORM POSTING_DATA.                                  
*  ENDLOOP.                                       

  LOOP AT IT_0102  WHERE MARK   EQ 'X'
                     AND BELNR  NE SPACE.
    CLEAR BKPF.
    SELECT SINGLE *
             FROM BKPF
            WHERE BUKRS = IT_0102-ZBUKR
              AND BELNR = IT_0102-BELNR
              AND GJAHR = IT_0102-BUDAT(04)
              AND STBLG = SPACE.
    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      PERFORM DOCUMENT_CANCEL.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.                    " VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT_CANCEL
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION                              
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION USING P_OPTION.

  DATA : LV_BKTXT LIKE BKPF-BKTXT,
         LV_BLART LIKE BKPF-BLART,
         LV_HKONT LIKE T012K-HKONT,
         LV_TOAMT LIKE ZFBT102-TRAN_AMT.
  DATA : LV_SAKNR LIKE SKA1-SAKNR.

  REFRESH : IT_DOCL.
  CLEAR   : IT_DOCH, IT_DOCL, G_MESSAGE_S, LV_TOAMT.

  LV_TOAMT = IT_0102-REMAIN_AMT + IT_0102-FEE_AMT.

  CLEAR : LV_BKTXT, LV_BLART.
  CASE P_OPTION.
    WHEN 'SA'. "선수금
      LV_BKTXT = '[펌뱅킹] 고객입금'.
      LV_BLART = 'T3'.
    WHEN 'GE'. "가수금
      LV_BKTXT = '[펌뱅킹] 입금'.
      LV_BLART = 'T3'.
  ENDCASE.

  IF IT_0102-ALLFE = 'X'.
    LV_BKTXT = '[펌뱅킹] 수수료입금 '.
  ENDIF.

  "전표헤더
  IT_DOCL-STYPE = 'S'.
  IT_DOCH-TCODE = 'FB01'.
  IT_DOCH-BLDAT = IT_0102-TRNDT.
  IT_DOCH-BLART = LV_BLART.
  IT_DOCH-BUDAT = IT_0102-TRNDT.
  IT_DOCH-BUKRS = IT_0102-ZBUKR.
  IT_DOCH-WAERS = C_WAERS_KRW.
  IT_DOCH-BKTXT = LV_BKTXT.

  "차변
  IT_DOCL-STYPE = 'S'          ."계정유형
  IT_DOCL-NEWBS = '40'         ."전기키
  SELECT SINGLE HKONT
    INTO LV_HKONT
    FROM T012K
   WHERE BUKRS = IT_0102-ZBUKR
     AND HBKID = IT_0102-HBKID
     AND HKTID = IT_0102-HKTID.
  IT_DOCL-NEWKO = LV_HKONT.
  IT_DOCL-WRBTR = NUM16 = IT_0102-REMAIN_AMT.
  IT_DOCL-HBKID = IT_0102-HBKID.
  IT_DOCL-HKTID = IT_0102-HKTID.
  IT_DOCL-SGTXT = IT_0102-FNAME.
  APPEND IT_DOCL.CLEAR IT_DOCL.

  "대변
  CASE P_OPTION.
    WHEN 'SA'.  "고객선수금
      IT_DOCL-NEWBS = '50'.
      IT_DOCL-NEWKO = C_HKONT_COM.
      IT_DOCL-XREF2 = IT_0102-KUNNR.
      IT_DOCL-XREF3 = IT_0102-TEXT11.
    WHEN 'GE'.  "입금가계정
      IT_DOCL-NEWBS = '50'.
      IF IT_0102-ALLFE = 'X'.
        IT_DOCL-NEWKO = C_HKONT_FEE.
        IT_DOCL-KOSTL = C_KOSTL_FIN. "자금
      ELSE.
        IT_DOCL-NEWKO = C_HKONT_COM.
      ENDIF.
  ENDCASE.
  IT_DOCL-WRBTR = NUM16 = LV_TOAMT.
  IT_DOCL-SGTXT = IT_0102-FNAME.
  APPEND IT_DOCL.CLEAR IT_DOCL.

  IF IT_0102-FEE_AMT IS NOT INITIAL.
*........................................                                   &nbs
    IT_DOCL-STYPE = 'S'          ."계정유형
    IT_DOCL-NEWBS = '40'         ."전기키
    IT_DOCL-NEWKO = C_HKONT_FEE.  "수수료계정
    IT_DOCL-WRBTR = NUM16 = IT_0102-FEE_AMT.
    IT_DOCL-KOSTL = C_KOSTL_FIN. "자금
    CONCATENATE IT_0102-FNAME      '/'
                '입금 수수료 '
           INTO IT_DOCL-SGTXT.
    CONDENSE IT_DOCL-SGTXT NO-GAPS.
    APPEND IT_DOCL.CLEAR IT_DOCL.
  ENDIF.
*.....................................                                    &
* 전표생성                                        &nbs
  GV_MODE = 'N'.
  CALL FUNCTION 'ZFB_PROCESS_00002100 '
    EXPORTING
      DOCH    = IT_DOCH
      MODE    = GV_MODE
    IMPORTING
      MESSAGE = G_MESSAGE_S
    TABLES
      DOCL    = IT_DOCL.

  IF G_MESSAGE_S-MSGTY = 'S' AND G_MESSAGE_S-MSGNO = '312'.
    G_BELNR = G_MESSAGE_S-MSGV1.
    G_SUBRC = 0.
    CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERSION_EXIT_ALPHA_INPUT'
      EXPORTING
        INPUT  = G_BELNR
      IMPORTING
        OUTPUT = G_BELNR.

    UPDATE ZFBT102 SET BELNR     = G_BELNR
                       BUDAT     = IT_0102-TRNDT
                       GJAHR     = IT_0102-TRNDT(04)
                 WHERE ZBUKR     = IT_0102-ZBUKR
                   AND BANK_CODE = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
                   AND ENTE_CODE = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE
                   AND SEND_DATE = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
                   AND DOCU_CODE = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
                   AND UPMU_CODE = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
                   AND DOCU_NUMC = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC
                   AND TRNDT     = IT_0102-TRNDT
                   AND PART_SEQ  = IT_0102-PART_SEQ.
    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.
    G_SUBRC = 4.
    PERFORM CAPTURE_ERR_MSG.
    UPDATE ZFBT102  SET MSGV1      = W_MSG
                   WHERE ZBUKR     = IT_0102-ZBUKR
                     AND BANK_CODE = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
                     AND ENTE_CODE = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE
                     AND SEND_DATE = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
                     AND DOCU_CODE = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
                     AND UPMU_CODE = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
                     AND DOCU_NUMC = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC
                     AND TRNDT     = IT_0102-TRNDT
                     AND PART_SEQ  = IT_0102-PART_SEQ.
    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      COMMIT WORK.
      MESSAGE W_MSG TYPE 'S'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATIO
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  DOCUMENT_CANCEL                               
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM DOCUMENT_CANCEL .

  MOVE IT_0102-ZBUKR TO WA_TABLE-ZBUKR.
  CLEAR: GT_BDCDATA, GT_BDCDATA[], GT_MESSTAB, GT_MESSTAB[].
  WA_TABLE-LAUFD = IT_0102-BUDAT.
  WA_TABLE-BELNR = IT_0102-BELNR.
  WA_TABLE-STGRD = C_STGRD1.
  PERFORM SAPMF05A_0105    TABLES WA_TABLE.
  PERFORM CALL_TRANSACTION TABLES WA_TABLE USING 'FB08'.

ENDFORM.                    " DOCUMENT_CANCEL
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  SAPMF05A_0105                               &n
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*      -->P_WA_TABLE  text                               
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM SAPMF05A_0105  TABLES   WA_TABLE STRUCTURE WA_TABLE.

  PERFORM BDC_DYNPRO_FILL USING:
          'X' 'SAPMF05A'         '0105',
          ' ' 'BDC_CURSOR'       'UF05A-STGRD',
          ' ' 'BDC_OKCODE'       '/00',                   "저장
          ' ' 'RF05A-BELNS'      WA_TABLE-BELNR,          "전표번호
          ' ' 'BKPF-BUKRS'       WA_TABLE-ZBUKR,          "회사코드
          ' ' 'RF05A-GJAHS'      WA_TABLE-LAUFD(4).       "회계년도

  PERFORM BDC_DYNPRO_FILL USING:
          ' ' 'BDC_OKCODE'       '=BU',                  "저장
          ' ' 'UF05A-STGRD'      WA_TABLE-STGRD.         "역분개사유코드

ENDFORM.                    " SAPMF05A_0105
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  CALL_TRANSACTION                               
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*      -->P_WA_TABLE  text                               
*      -->P_2861   text                              &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM CALL_TRANSACTION TABLES   WA_TABLE STRUCTURE WA_TABLE
                       USING   FP_TCODE.

  DATA : LV_INIT_DATE LIKE SY-DATUM VALUE IS INITIAL.

  CLEAR: GS_CTUPAR, G_BDCRC.

*  GS_CTUPAR-DISMODE  = C_DISMODE_DISPLAY.   "A MODE                          &n
*  GS_CTUPAR-DISMODE  = C_DISMODE_ERRDISP.   "E MODE.                          &
  GS_CTUPAR-DISMODE  = C_DISMODE_NOTDISP.   "N MODE.
  GS_CTUPAR-UPDMODE  = C_UPDMODE_SYNC.
  GS_CTUPAR-CATTMODE = ' '.
  GS_CTUPAR-DEFSIZE  = 'X'.
  GS_CTUPAR-RACOMMIT = 'X'.
  GS_CTUPAR-NOBINPT  = ' '.
  GS_CTUPAR-NOBIEND  = ' '.

  CALL TRANSACTION FP_TCODE
             USING GT_BDCDATA
           OPTIONS FROM GS_CTUPAR
          MESSAGES INTO GT_MESSTAB.

  READ TABLE GT_MESSTAB WITH KEY MSGTYP = 'S'
                                 MSGID  = 'F5'
                                 MSGNR  = '312'.

  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
    UPDATE ZFBT102 SET BELNR   = SPACE
                       BUDAT   = LV_INIT_DATE
                       GJAHR   = SPACE
*                       HKONT1  = SPACE              &n
*                       KUNNR   = SPACE             &nb
*                       FEE_AMT = SPACE               &
                 WHERE ZBUKR   = IT_0102-ZBUKR
                   AND BELNR   = IT_0102-BELNR
                   AND BUDAT   = IT_0102-BUDAT.
*                     AND BANK_CODE  = IT_0102-BANK_CODE            &n
*                     AND ENTE_CODE  = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE            &n
*                     AND SEND_DATE  = IT_0102-SEND_DATE            &n
*                     AND DOCU_CODE  = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE            &n
*                     AND UPMU_CODE  = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE            &n
*                     AND DOCU_NUMC  = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC            &n
*                     AND TRNDT      = IT_0102-TRNDT         &nbs
*                     AND PART_SEQ   = IT_0102-PART_SEQ.           &nb
    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      COMMIT WORK.
      MESSAGE S000
         WITH '역분개 처리 되었습니다.'.
    ENDIF.
  ELSE.
    PERFORM CAPTURE_ERR_MSG.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH W_MSG.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " CALL_TRANSACTION

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
MODULE CHECK_BELNR INPUT.

  IF OK_CODE = 'ENTE'.
    CLEAR : BKPF.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM BKPF
                   WHERE BUKRS = P_BUKRS
                     AND BELNR = GC_BELNR
                     AND GJAHR = G_GJAHR.
    IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.
      MESSAGE E000 WITH '전표번호를 확인하십시오.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
ENDMODULE.                 " CHECK_BELNR  INPU
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  VAL_PROCESS_CUSTOMER                              &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM VAL_PROCESS_CUSTOMER .

  READ TABLE IT_0102  WITH KEY MARK = 'X'.
  IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.
    MESSAGE I006. EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK  EQ 'X'.
    IF IT_0102-BELNR NE SPACE.
      MESSAGE I000 WITH '전표처리가 되어 수정할 수 없습니다.'.
    ELSE.
      MOVE IT_0102-BANK_CODE       TO  G_BANK.
      MOVE IT_0102-TEXT            TO  G_BANK_NAME.
      MOVE IT_0102-TRNDT           TO  G_TRNDT.
      MOVE IT_0102-TRNNO           TO  G_TRNNO.
      MOVE IT_0102-TRAN_AMT        TO  G_TRAN_AMT.
      MOVE IT_0102-FNAME           TO  G_FNAME.
      MOVE IT_0102-KUNNR           TO  G_KUNNR.
      MOVE IT_0102-KUNNRM          TO  G_NAME.
      CALL SCREEN '0300'  STARTING AT  15  005.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.                    " VAL_PROCESS_CUSTOMER

*&      Module  CHECK_FIELD_0300  INPUT                           &nbs
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
MODULE CHECK_FIELD_0300 INPUT.

  DATA : LV_KUNNR LIKE KNA1-KUNNR.

  IF OK_CODE NE '0300_CN'.
    IF NOT G_KUNNR IS INITIAL.
      CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERSION_EXIT_ALPHA_INPUT'
        EXPORTING
          INPUT  = G_KUNNR
        IMPORTING
          OUTPUT = G_KUNNR.
      SELECT SINGLE NAME1 FROM KNA1 INTO G_NAME
                         WHERE KUNNR = G_KUNNR.
      IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.
        MESSAGE E000 WITH '거래처코드를 확인하십시오.'.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      CLEAR G_NAME.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

ENDMODULE.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Module  USER_COMMAND_0300  INPUT                           &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
MODULE USER_COMMAND_0300 INPUT.

  CASE OK_CODE.
    WHEN '0300_OK'.
      READ TABLE IT_0102 WITH KEY ZBUKR = IT_0102-ZBUKR
                              BANK_CODE = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
                              ENTE_CODE = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE
                              SEND_DATE = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
                              DOCU_CODE = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
                              UPMU_CODE = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
                              DOCU_NUMC = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC
                              TRNDT     = IT_0102-TRNDT.
      IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
        MOVE G_KUNNR     TO IT_0102-KUNNR.
        MOVE G_NAME      TO IT_0102-KUNNRM.
        MODIFY IT_0102   INDEX SY-TABIX.

        UPDATE ZFBT102  SET KUNNR      = G_KUNNR
                       WHERE ZBUKR      = IT_0102-ZBUKR
                         AND BANK_CODE  = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
                         AND ENTE_CODE  = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE
                         AND SEND_DATE  = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
                         AND DOCU_CODE  = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
                         AND UPMU_CODE  = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
                         AND DOCU_NUMC  = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC
                         AND TRNDT      = IT_0102-TRNDT.
        IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
          COMMIT WORK.
        ENDIF.
        MESSAGE S000 WITH '저장하였습니다.'.
        CLEAR OK_CODE.
        LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.
      ENDIF.

    WHEN '0300_CN'.
      MESSAGE S000 WITH '작업을 취소하였습니다!'.
      CLEAR OK_CODE.
      LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.

  ENDCASE.

ENDMODULE.                 " USER_COMMAND_0300  INPUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT_GE                             &nbs
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT_GE .

  DATA : L_CHK(01)  TYPE C.
  DATA : L_CHK1(01) TYPE C.

  READ TABLE IT_0102  WITH KEY MARK = 'X'.
  IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.
    MESSAGE S006. EXIT.
  ENDIF.


  "펌뱅킹 이체분 입금적요 관련 로직 체크
  CLEAR : L_CHK1, G_MESSAGE, GV_CHK.
  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK       = 'X'
                    AND BELNR      = SPACE
                    AND TRGUBN     = '11'
*                    AND TRDIV      = '20'            &
                    AND REMAIN_AMT <> SPACE.

    IF IT_0102-FNAME = '사내계좌이체' OR
      IT_0102-FNAME = '자동집금당행' OR
      IT_0102-FNAME = '자동집금최종' .
      L_CHK1 = 'X'.
      CONCATENATE '처리 대상 중 시스템에서'
                  '이체한 [ 적요 :' IT_0102-FNAME
                  '] 　　　데이터가 존재합니다. 진행하시겠습니까?'
             INTO G_MESSAGE SEPARATED BY SPACE.
    ENDIF.


    IF SY-SYSID = C_SYSID_PRD AND IT_0102-TRNDT < C_OPNDT.
      MESSAGE I999. GV_CHK = 'X'. EXIT.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
  CHECK GV_CHK = SPACE.

  IF L_CHK1 = 'X'.
    PERFORM CONFIRM_POPUP
      USING '[전표처리 확인 Message]'
            G_MESSAGE SPACE SPACE
   CHANGING G_ANSWER.
    CHECK G_ANSWER = '1'.
  ENDIF.
*                                          &n
*  "가수처리계정 입력                                      
*  CLEAR : G_0900_HKONT, G_NAME, OK_CODE, G_FEE_AMT.                            
*  CALL SCREEN 0100 STARTING AT 15 05.                             &nb
*  CHECK OK_CODE = '0100_OK'.                                 &nb

  CLEAR L_CHK.
  LOOP AT IT_0102  WHERE MARK   EQ 'X'
                     AND BELNR  EQ SPACE
                     AND TRGUBN EQ '11'
*                     AND TRDIV  EQ '20'               
*                     AND KUNNR  EQ SPACE               
                     AND REMAIN_AMT <> SPACE.

    L_CHK = 'X'.
    IF IT_0102-KUNNR <> SPACE.
      PERFORM RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION USING 'SA'.
    ELSE.
      PERFORM RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION USING 'GE'.
    ENDIF.
*    PERFORM RECE_DOCUMENT_CREATION USING 'GE'.                             
  ENDLOOP.

  IF L_CHK = SPACE.
    MESSAGE S000 WITH '전표 생성할 데이터를 선택하세요.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT_GE
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT_PART                             &n
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT_PART .

  DATA : LV_CHK(01) TYPE C,
         LV_CNT     TYPE I.

  DATA : LV_UBKNT_CHAR(18) TYPE C.
  CLEAR : GS_PART, OK_CODE.

  READ TABLE IT_0102 WITH KEY MARK = 'X'.
  IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
    MESSAGE S000
       WITH '분할 대상을 선택하여 주십시요.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CLEAR LV_CHK.
  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK = 'X'
                    AND BELNR <> SPACE.
    LV_CHK = 'X'.
    EXIT.
  ENDLOOP.
  IF LV_CHK = 'X'.
    MESSAGE S000
       WITH '이미 입금처리 된 데이터 입니다.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CLEAR LV_CHK.
  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK       = 'X'
                    AND REMAIN_AMT = SPACE.
    LV_CHK = 'X'.
    EXIT.
  ENDLOOP.
  IF LV_CHK = 'X'.
    MESSAGE S000
       WITH '처리대상 금액이 "0"원 입니다.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE IT_0102 WITH KEY MARK      = 'X'
                              PART_GUBN = 'X'.
  IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
    MESSAGE S000
       WITH '분할하여 생성된 거래내역은 분할 할 수 없습니다.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CLEAR LV_CNT.
  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK  = 'X'.
    LV_CNT = LV_CNT + 1.
  ENDLOOP.
  IF LV_CNT > 1.
    MESSAGE I000
       WITH '한 건씩 진행하여 주십시요.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CLEAR : GS_PART, GT_PAMT.
  REFRESH GT_PAMT.

  READ TABLE IT_0102 WITH KEY MARK = 'X'.
  IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
    MOVE : IT_0102-BANK_CODE1 TO GS_PART-BANK_CODE1,
           IT_0102-TRNDT      TO GS_PART-TRNDT,
           IT_0102-TRAN_AMT   TO GS_PART-TRAN_AMT,
           IT_0102-REMAIN_AMT TO GS_PART-REMAIN_AMT,
           IT_0102-UBKNT      TO GS_PART-BANKN.

    CLEAR GS_PART-TEXT.
    SELECT SINGLE TEXT
             INTO GS_PART-TEXT
             FROM ZFBT056
            WHERE BANK_CODE1 = GS_PART-BANK_CODE1.

    IF NOT GS_PART IS INITIAL.
      DO 7 TIMES.
        CLEAR GT_PAMT. APPEND GT_PAMT.
      ENDDO.
      CALL SCREEN 0600 STARTING AT 20 5.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " VAL_PROCESS_DOCUMENT_PART

MODULE USER_COMMAND_0600 INPUT.

  CASE OK_CODE.
    WHEN '0600_OK'.
      PERFORM CONFIRM_POPUP
        USING '[거래내역 분할]'
              '거래내역을 분할 하시겠습니까?'
              SPACE SPACE
     CHANGING G_ANSWER.
      CHECK G_ANSWER = '1'.
      PERFORM INSERT_ZFBT102.
    WHEN '0600_CANC'.
      MESSAGE S000
         WITH '취소 되었습니다.'.
      CLEAR OK_CODE.
      LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.
  ENDCASE.

  CLEAR OK_CODE.

ENDMODULE.                 " USER_COMMAND_0600  INPUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  CONFIRM_POPUP                               &n
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*      -->P_5034   text                              &nbs
*      -->P_5035   text                              &nbs
*      -->P_SPACE  text                               &nb
*      -->P_SPACE  text                               &nb
*      <--P_G_ANSWER  text                               
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM CONFIRM_POPUP  USING P_TITLE P_TEXT P_CANC P_TYPE
                 CHANGING P_ANSWER.

  CLEAR P_ANSWER.
  CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_CONFIRM'
    EXPORTING
      TITLEBAR              = P_TITLE
      TEXT_QUESTION         = P_TEXT
      TEXT_BUTTON_1         = '예'
      ICON_BUTTON_1         = ' '
      TEXT_BUTTON_2         = '아니오'
      ICON_BUTTON_2         = ' '
      DEFAULT_BUTTON        = '2'
      DISPLAY_CANCEL_BUTTON = P_CANC
      START_COLUMN          = 25
      START_ROW             = 6
      POPUP_TYPE            = P_TYPE
    IMPORTING
      ANSWER                = P_ANSWER
    EXCEPTIONS
      TEXT_NOT_FOUND        = 1
      OTHERS                = 2.

ENDFORM.                    " CONFIRM_POPUP
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  CONFIRM_POPUP                               &n
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*      -->P_5034   text                              &nbs
*      -->P_5035   text                              &nbs
*      -->P_SPACE  text                               &nb
*      -->P_SPACE  text                               &nb
*      <--P_G_ANSWER  text                               
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM CONFIRM_POPUP_DOCU  USING P_TITLE P_TEXT P_TEXT2 P_CANC P_TYPE
                      CHANGING P_ANSWER.

  DATA : LV_TEXT(100) TYPE C.
  CLEAR: P_ANSWER, LV_TEXT.

  CONCATENATE P_TEXT P_TEXT2
         INTO LV_TEXT.
  CONDENSE LV_TEXT.

  CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_CONFIRM'
    EXPORTING
      TITLEBAR              = P_TITLE
      TEXT_QUESTION         = LV_TEXT
      TEXT_BUTTON_1         = '선수금처리'
      ICON_BUTTON_1         = ' '
      TEXT_BUTTON_2         = '예수금처리'
      ICON_BUTTON_2         = ' '
      DEFAULT_BUTTON        = '2'
      DISPLAY_CANCEL_BUTTON = P_CANC
      START_COLUMN          = 25
      START_ROW             = 6
      POPUP_TYPE            = P_TYPE
    IMPORTING
      ANSWER                = P_ANSWER
    EXCEPTIONS
      TEXT_NOT_FOUND        = 1
      OTHERS                = 2.

ENDFORM.                    " CONFIRM_POPUP_DOCU
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  DOCUMENT_POST                               &n
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM DOCUMENT_POST .

*  DATA : LV_CNT     TYPE I.                             &nb
*                                          &n
*  DATA : LV_BELNR   LIKE BKPF-BELNR,                             &nbs
*         LV_GJAHR   LIKE BKPF-GJAHR,                         &nb
*         LV_BUDAT   LIKE BKPF-BUDAT.                         &nb
*                                          &n
*  DATA : LV_MESSAGE(100) TYPE C.                                
*                                          &n
*  DATA : L_TEXT(30) TYPE C,                                 
*         L_TEXT1    LIKE BSEG-SGTXT.                        &nbs
*  DATA : NUM16(16) TYPE N,                                 
*         NUM14(14) TYPE N.                             
*                                          &n
*  DATA : L_TOT_AMT       LIKE ZFBT102-TRAN_AMT.                        &nb
*  DATA : L_TRAN_AMT      TYPE BBSEG-WRBTR,                          &
*         L_GAP_AMT       TYPE BBSEG-WRBTR,                     &
*         L_FEE_AMT       TYPE BBSEG-WRBTR,                     &
*         L_PART_AMT(15)  TYPE C.                           
*                                          &n
*  DATA : SEL01           LIKE RF05A-SEL01.                      
*                                          &n
*  CLEAR : L_TRAN_AMT, L_GAP_AMT, LV_BELNR,                              &n
*          LV_GJAHR,   LV_BUDAT,  BDC_TAB,                       
*          MESSTAB,    L_TEXT1.                         &nbs
*                                          &n
*  REFRESH : BDC_TAB, MESSTAB.                                 &n
*                                          &n
**  L_TRAN_AMT = NUM16 = GS_PART-PART_AMT.                              &nb
**  L_TRAN_AMT = NUM16 = GS_PART-CURR_AMT.                              &nb
**  L_FEE_AMT  = NUM16 = GS_PART-FEE_AMT.                              
**  L_TOT_AMT  = GS_PART-PART_AMT. " + GS_PART-FEE_AMT.                          &nbs
*  L_PART_AMT = L_TOT_AMT.                                   
**  L_PART_AMT = NUM16 = L_TOT_AMT.                               &nbs
**  L_GAP_AMT  = GS_PART-GAP_AMT.                                 
*  L_TEXT     = '펌뱅킹 어음할인(분할)'.                              
**  CONCATENATE L_TEXT  GS_PART-NAME1                                &
**         INTO L_TEXT1 SEPARATED BY SPACE.                        &nb
*                                          &n
*  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :                                  &
*   'X'  'SAPMF05A'     '0122'                ,  " Posting and Clearing     
*   ' '  'BDC_OKCODE'   '/00'                 ,  " ENTER(OK-CODE)       &nb
*   ' '  'BKPF-BLDAT'   GS_PART-TRIDT               ,  " Document Date       &nb
*   ' '  'BKPF-BLART'   'DZ'                  ,  " Document Type      
*   ' '  'BKPF-BUKRS'   '1000'                 ,  " Company Code       
*   ' '  'BKPF-BUDAT'   GS_PART-TRIDT               ,  " Posting Date       &nbs
*   ' '  'BKPF-MONAT'   GS_PART-TRIDT+4(02)         ,  " Period              &nb
*   ' '  'BKPF-WAERS'   'KRW'                 ,  " Currency        &nb
*   ' '  'BKPF-BKTXT'   L_TEXT,                              
*   ' '  'RF05A-NEWBS'  '40'                  ,  " Posting key (차변)1     &n
*   ' '  'RF05A-NEWKO'  GS_PART-HKONT         .  " Account     (차변)1          &n
**   ' '  'RF05A-NEWUM'  'W'                   .  " Special G/L (차변)1    &n
*                                          &n
** 외화 수수료가 발생했을 경우 수수료 입력                                 &n
*  IF NOT GS_PART-FEE_AMT IS INITIAL.                               &n
*    PERFORM DYNPRO USING :                                &
*     'X'  'SAPMF05A'     '0300'         ,  " G/L account line item         
*     ' '  'BDC_OKCODE'   '/00'          ,  " (OK-CODE)             &n
*     ' '  'BSEG-WRBTR'   L_TRAN_AMT     ,  " Amount                  
*     ' '  'BSEG-ZUONR'   GS_PART-BILNU(18)  ,  " 지정=어음번호                   &nbs
*     ' '  'BSEG-SGTXT'   L_TEXT1        ,  " 텍스트=구분텍스트+구매처명              &
*     ' '  'RF05A-NEWBS'  '40'                  ,  " Posting key (차변)1   &n
*     ' '  'RF05A-NEWKO'  '861-06-001'       .  " Account     (차변)1          &nb
*                                          &n
**    PERFORM DYNPRO USING :                                
**         'X'  'SAPLKACB'           '0002'         ,  "     &nbs
**         ' '  'BDC_OKCODE'         '=ENTE'        .  "       &n
*                                          &n
*    PERFORM DYNPRO USING :                                &
*     'X'  'SAPMF05A'     '0300'         ,  " G/L account line item         
*     ' '  'BDC_OKCODE'   '=SL'          ,  " (OK-CODE)             &n
*     ' '  'BSEG-WRBTR'   L_FEE_AMT      ,  " Amount                 &
*     ' '  'COBL-KOSTL'   'JAA'          ,                  
*     ' '  'BSEG-ZUONR'   GS_PART-BILNU(18)  ,  " 지정=어음번호                   &nbs
*     ' '  'BSEG-SGTXT'   L_TEXT1        .                   &nbs
*  ELSE.                                       &nb
*    PERFORM DYNPRO USING :                                &
*     'X'  'SAPMF05A'     '0300'         ,  " G/L account line item         
*     ' '  'BDC_OKCODE'   '=SL'          ,  " (OK-CODE)             &n
*     ' '  'BSEG-WRBTR'   L_TRAN_AMT     ,  " Amount                  
*     ' '  'BSEG-ZUONR'   GS_PART-BILNU  ,  " 지정=어음번호                    &n
*     ' '  'BSEG-SGTXT'   L_TEXT1  .                         &nbs
*  ENDIF.                                       &n
*                                          &n
**  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :                                  
**       'X'  'SAPLKACB'           '0002'         ,  "       &nbs
**       ' '  'BDC_OKCODE'         '=ENTE'        ,  "         &n
**       ' '  'BSEG-KOSTL'         'JAA'          .          
*                                          &n
*  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :                                  &
*       'X'   'SAPMF05A'         '0710'       , "            
*       ' '   'RF05A-AGBUK'      '1000'        , "            &nb
*       ' '   'RF05A-AGKOA'      'D'          , "           
*       ' '   'RF05A-AGUMS'      'W'          , "           
*       ' '   'RF05A-XNOPS'      ' '          , "          &
*       ' '   'RF05A-XPOS1(01)'  ' '          , "             &nb
*       ' '   'RF05A-XPOS1(03)'  'X'          , "              &n
*       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '/00'        . "            
*                                          &n
**  CONCATENATE GS_PART-BELNR GS_PART-GJAHR GS_PART-BUZEI INTO SEL01.                         &
*  PERFORM SCREEN_I USING GS_PART-BELNR.                     "SEL01.         &nb
*                                          &n
*  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :                                  &
*       'X'   'SAPMF05A'         '0731'       , "            
*       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=PA'        . "            
*                                          &n
*  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :                                  &
*       'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '3100'       , "            
*       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=PART'      . "             &nb
**       ' '   'RF05A-ABPOS'      '1'.                      
*                                          &n
*  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :                                  &
*       'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '3100'       , "            
*       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=OSU'       .              
*                                          &n
*  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :                                  &
*       'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '2000'       , "            
*       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=GO'        , "            
*       ' '   'RF05A-XPOS1(03)'      'X'.                     &nb
*                                          &n
*  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :                                  &
*       'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '0731'        , "           
*       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=GO'         , "           
*       ' '   'RF05A-SEL01(01)'  GS_PART-BELNR.                        
*                                          &n
*  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :                                  &
*       'X' 'SAPDF05X'           '3100'          , "         
*       ' ' 'BDC_OKCODE'         'OMX'           . "         
*                                          &n
*  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :                                  &
*       'X' 'SAPDF05X'           '3100'          , "         
*       ' ' 'BDC_OKCODE'         'Z+'           . "         
*                                          &n
*  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :                                  &
*       'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '3100'        , "           
*       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '/00'         , "           
*       ' '   'DF05B-PSZAH(01)'  L_PART_AMT    .                    &n
*                                          &n
*  PERFORM DYNPRO USING :                                  &
*       'X'   'SAPDF05X'         '3100'        , " "분할금액입력,저장        &
*       ' '   'BDC_OKCODE'       '=BU'         . "           
*                                          &n
*  PERFORM CALL_TRANS USING 'FB05' 'E'.                               
*                                          &n
*  READ TABLE MESSTAB WITH KEY MSGTYP = 'S'                            
*                              MSGNR  = '312'.       &n
*  IF SY-SUBRC = 0.                                   &
*    WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS.                               &nb
*    LV_BELNR = MESSTAB-MSGV1.                                &nb
*                                          &n
*    CALL FUNCTION 'CONVERSION_EXIT_ALPHA_INPUT'                             &nb
*      EXPORTING                                   
*        INPUT  = LV_BELNR                             
*      IMPORTING                                   
*        OUTPUT = LV_BELNR.                             &nbs
*                                          &n
*    CLEAR BKPF.                                   &nbs
*    SELECT SINGLE * FROM BKPF                               
*                   WHERE BUKRS = P_BUKRS                 &n
*                     AND BELNR = LV_BELNR               &nb
*                     AND GJAHR = GS_PART-TRIDT(04).              
*    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.                                 &
*      LV_GJAHR = BKPF-GJAHR.                               
*      LV_BUDAT = BKPF-BUDAT.                               
****      PERFORM INSERT_ZFBT102 USING LV_BELNR LV_GJAHR LV_BUDAT.                      &n
*    ELSE.                                     &nb
*      CONCATENATE '전표번호:'                                &n
*                  LV_BELNR                       
*                  ':전표생성 확인 중 오류가 발생하였습니다.'                 
*             INTO LV_MESSAGE.                          
*      CLEAR LV_BELNR.                                 
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*  ELSE.                                       &nb
*    READ TABLE MESSTAB WITH KEY MSGTYP = 'E'.                         &nbs
*    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.                                 &
*      CALL FUNCTION 'MESSAGE_TEXT_BUILD'                             
*        EXPORTING                                 
*          MSGID               = MESSTAB-MSGID             &
*          MSGNR               = MESSTAB-MSGNR             &
*          MSGV1               = MESSTAB-MSGV1             &
*          MSGV2               = MESSTAB-MSGV2             &
*          MSGV3               = MESSTAB-MSGV3             &
*          MSGV4               = MESSTAB-MSGV4             &
*        IMPORTING                                 
*          MESSAGE_TEXT_OUTPUT = LV_MESSAGE.                         &
*    ELSE.                                     &nb
*      READ TABLE MESSTAB WITH KEY MSGTYP = 'S'.                       &nbs
*      IF SY-SUBRC = 0.                               &
*        CALL FUNCTION 'MESSAGE_TEXT_BUILD'                           
*          EXPORTING                               
*            MSGID               = MESSTAB-MSGID           &
*            MSGNR               = MESSTAB-MSGNR           &
*            MSGV1               = MESSTAB-MSGV1           &
*            MSGV2               = MESSTAB-MSGV2           &
*            MSGV3               = MESSTAB-MSGV3           &
*            MSGV4               = MESSTAB-MSGV4           &
*          IMPORTING                               
*            MESSAGE_TEXT_OUTPUT = LV_MESSAGE.                       &
*      ENDIF.                                   &n
*    ENDIF.                                     &n
*  ENDIF.                                       &n

ENDFORM.                    " DOCUMENT_POST
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  INSERT_ZFBT102                               &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM INSERT_ZFBT102 .

  DATA : LV_CHK(01)   TYPE C.

  DATA : LV_TEXT(100) TYPE C,
         LV_AMT(17)   TYPE C.
  DATA : LS_0102 LIKE ZFBT102.
  DATA : LV_PART_SEQ LIKE ZFBT102-PART_SEQ.

  DELETE GT_PAMT WHERE TRAN_AMT IS INITIAL.

  CLEAR LV_CHK.
  LOOP AT GT_PAMT.
    CLEAR LS_0102.
    READ TABLE IT_0102 WITH KEY MARK = 'X'.
    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING IT_0102 TO LS_0102.
      MOVE : GT_PAMT-TRAN_AMT    TO LS_0102-TRAN_AMT.

      CLEAR LV_PART_SEQ.
      SELECT MAX( PART_SEQ )
        INTO LV_PART_SEQ
        FROM ZFBT102
       WHERE ZBUKR     = IT_0102-ZBUKR
         AND BANK_CODE = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
         AND SEND_DATE = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
         AND DOCU_CODE = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
         AND UPMU_CODE = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
         AND DOCU_NUMC = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC
         AND TRNDT     = IT_0102-TRNDT
         AND TRNNO     = IT_0102-TRNNO.

      LV_PART_SEQ = LV_PART_SEQ + 1.

      MOVE : LV_PART_SEQ TO LS_0102-PART_SEQ,
             'X'         TO LS_0102-PART_GUBN.

      INSERT ZFBT102 FROM LS_0102.
      IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
        COMMIT WORK.
        WAIT UP TO '0.5' SECONDS.
      ELSE.
        CLEAR : LV_AMT, LV_TEXT.
        WRITE LS_0102-TRAN_AMT TO LV_AMT.
        CONCATENATE '[ 금액:' LV_AMT ']'
                    '거래내역 생성 중 오류가 발생하였습니다.'
                    '다시 생성하여 주십시요.'
               INTO LV_TEXT SEPARATED BY SPACE.
        MESSAGE LV_TEXT TYPE 'I'.
        LV_CHK = 'X'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

  IF LV_CHK = SPACE.
    MESSAGE S000
       WITH '분할처리 되었습니다. 내역을 확인하여 주십시요.'.
    LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " INSERT_ZFBT102

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
MODULE TRANSP_OUT OUTPUT.

  READ TABLE GT_PAMT INDEX SY-STEPL.

ENDMODULE.                 " TRANSP_OUT  OUTPUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Module  TRANSP_IN  INPUT                             
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
MODULE TRANSP_IN INPUT.

  IF GT_PAMT-TRAN_AMT > GS_PART-REMAIN_AMT.
    MESSAGE I000
       WITH '분할 후 잔액보다 큰 금액을 입력 할 수 없습니다.'.
    CLEAR : OK_CODE, GT_PAMT-TRAN_AMT.
  ELSE.
    GS_PART-REMAIN_AMT = GS_PART-REMAIN_AMT - GT_PAMT-TRAN_AMT.
  ENDIF.

  MODIFY GT_PAMT INDEX SY-STEPL.

ENDMODULE.                 " TRANSP_IN  INPUT

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
MODULE SET_REMIAN_AMT INPUT.

  GS_PART-REMAIN_AMT = IT_0102-REMAIN_AMT.

ENDMODULE.                 " SET_REMIAN_AMT  INPUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      Form  DELETE_PART_DATA                               
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*       text                                  &nbs
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*  -->  p1        text                            &n
*  <--  p2        text                            &n
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM DELETE_PART_DATA .

  DATA : LV_CHK(01) TYPE C.

  READ TABLE IT_0102 WITH KEY MARK = 'X'.
  IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
    MESSAGE S006.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE IT_0102 WITH KEY MARK      = 'X'
                              PART_GUBN = SPACE.
  IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
    MESSAGE S000
       WITH '원 거래내역은 삭제 할 수 없습니다.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CLEAR LV_CHK.
  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK       = 'X'
                    AND PART_GUBN  = 'X'
                    AND BELNR     <> SPACE.
    LV_CHK = 'X'.
  ENDLOOP.
  IF LV_CHK = 'X'.
    MESSAGE S000
       WITH '입금처리 된 건은 삭제 할 수 없습니다.'.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  PERFORM CONFIRM_POPUP
    USING '[분할내역 삭제확인]'
          '분할 한 거래내역을 삭제 하시겠습니까?'
          SPACE SPACE
 CHANGING G_ANSWER.
  CHECK G_ANSWER = '1'.

  CLEAR LV_CHK.
  LOOP AT IT_0102 WHERE MARK        = 'X'
                    AND PART_GUBN   = 'X'
                    AND BELNR       = SPACE.
    CLEAR ZFBT102.
    SELECT SINGLE *
             FROM ZFBT102
            WHERE ZBUKR      = IT_0102-ZBUKR
              AND BANK_CODE  = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
              AND ENTE_CODE  = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE
              AND SEND_DATE  = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
              AND DOCU_CODE  = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
              AND UPMU_CODE  = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
              AND DOCU_NUMC  = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC
              AND TRNDT      = IT_0102-TRNDT
              AND PART_GUBN  = SPACE.
    IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
      IF ZFBT102-BELNR IS INITIAL.
        DELETE FROM ZFBT102 WHERE ZBUKR = IT_0102-ZBUKR
                               AND BANK_CODE = IT_0102-BANK_CODE
                               AND ENTE_CODE = IT_0102-ENTE_CODE
                               AND SEND_DATE = IT_0102-SEND_DATE
                               AND DOCU_CODE = IT_0102-DOCU_CODE
                               AND UPMU_CODE = IT_0102-UPMU_CODE
                               AND DOCU_NUMC = IT_0102-DOCU_NUMC
                               AND TRNDT     = IT_0102-TRNDT
                               AND PART_SEQ  = IT_0102-PART_SEQ
                               AND PART_GUBN = 'X'.
        IF SY-SUBRC = 0.
          COMMIT WORK.
          LV_CHK = 'X'.
        ENDIF.
      ELSE.
        LV_CHK = 'F'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

  IF LV_CHK = 'X'.
    MESSAGE S000
       WITH '삭제 되었습니다.'.
  ELSEIF LV_CHK = 'F'.
    MESSAGE I000
       WITH '원 거래내역의 입금전표가 '
            '생성된 건은 삭제 할 수 없습니다.'
            '확인 후 다시 처리하여 주십시요.'.
  ELSE.
    MESSAGE S000
       WITH '삭제 처리 중 오류가 발생하였습니다.'.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " DELETE_PART_DATA
